basic.description:

向前方进行至多五段的打击，造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 strikes ahead, dealing Physical DMG.

special.name: 特殊技：软糖轰击

special.description:

special.descriptionEn:

Fire a cannon shot forward, dealing Physical DMG.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：小心蛀牙
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向敌人扔出炸弹，造成物理伤害；
重击命中敌人时，会使其陷入[甜蜜惊吓]状态；
发动时，获得2点[甜度点]；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Throw a bomb at the enemy, dealing Physical DMG.
Upon hitting an enemy with a heavy attack, it inflicts the Sweet Scare state.
Gains 2 Sugar Points upon activation.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：报复开始~
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行快速打击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Deliver a quick strike forward, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：恶作剧合战
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方小范围敌人发动强力打击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动时，获得1点[甜度点]；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleash a powerful strike on enemies in a small area ahead, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Gains 1 Sugar Points when used.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：不投降就捣乱
ultimate.nameEn: Ultimate: Surrender or Suffer the Mischief
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating reaches Maximum, press [Ultimate] to trigger:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对周身大范围敌人发动强力打击，造成大量物理伤害；
重击命中敌人时，会使其陷入[甜蜜惊吓]状态；
招式发动时，队伍中其他角色回复8.5点能量； 
招式发动时，获得2点[甜度点]；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating reaches Maximum, press [Ultimate] to trigger:
Unleash a powerful strike on enemies in a large area around the character, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Enemies hit with a heavy attack are inflicted with the Sweet Scare state.
Upon activating this skill, other squad members gain 8.5 Energy.
Upon activating this skill, gain 2 Sugar Points.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：甜点时间
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text:
进入战场时，柚叶立刻获得3点[甜度点]；
柚叶最多持有6点[甜度点]；
柚叶的[强化特殊技：小心蛀牙]、[强化特殊技：小心蛀牙，就是现在！]和[终结技：不投降就捣乱]攻击命中敌人时，为全队角色施加[狸之愿]效果；
[狸之愿]效果会提供等同于柚叶的40%初始攻击力的攻击力加成，最多提升1200点，并使拥有者造成的伤害提升15%，持续40秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
当柚叶的初始攻击力达到3000点时，为全队角色提供的攻击力增益效果达到最大值。
facts.textEn:
Upon entering the battlefield, Yuzuha immediately gains 3 Sugar Points.
Yuzuha can have up to 6 Sugar Points.
When Yuzuha's EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, Right Now!, or Ultimate: Surrender or Suffer the Mischief hits an enemy, all squad members receive the Tanuki Wish effect.
Tanuki Wish grants an ATK increase equal to 40% of Yuzuha's initial ATK, up to a maximum increase of 1,200, and increases the DMG dealt by those with the effect by 15%, lasting 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
If Yuzuha's initial ATK reaches 3,000, she grants the full ATK bonus to all squad members.

cinema.name: 幸运体质
cinema.description: 柚叶进入战场时，回复30点能量，在勘域模式中该效果每180秒最多触发一次；处于[甜蜜惊吓]状态下的敌人全属性伤害抗性降低10%；[额外能力]中属性异常伤害和[紊乱]伤害增益效果提升至原本的130%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Yuzuha regains 30 Energy when she enters the battlefield. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger at most once every 180s. Enemies in the Sweet Scare state have their All-Attribute RES reduced by 10%. The Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG buff from her Additional Ability is increased to 130% of its original value.

cinema.name: 趣友云集
cinema.description: 柚叶的[强化特殊技：小心蛀牙]、[强化特殊技：小心蛀牙，就是现在！]和[终结技：不投降就捣乱]攻击命中敌人时，会使全队角色造成的伤害提升15%，属性异常积蓄效率提升15%，持续40秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，重击命中不处于失衡状态的敌人时，会强制触发[连携技]，通过该种方式发动的[连携技]，打断等级降低，强制触发[连携技]的效果每20秒最多触发一次；其他角色通过[连携技]入场时，柚叶会获得1点[甜度点]；柚叶触发[普通攻击：硬糖射击]的冷却时间减少25%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Yuzuha's EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, Right Now!, or Ultimate: Surrender or Suffer the Mischief hits an enemy, all squad members' DMG increases by 15% and Anomaly Buildup Rate by 15%, lasting 40s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When a heavy attack hits an enemy that is not Stunned, it will trigger a forced Chain Attack. Chain Attacks triggered this way have reduced Interrupt Level and forced Chain Attacks can only occur once every 20s. Whenever another character enters through a Chain Attack, Yuzuha gains 1 Sugar Points. Yuzuha's Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot cooldown is reduced by 25%.

cinema.name: 幽城童话
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 坠落魔法
cinema.description: 柚叶的[支援突击：夹心硬糖射击]和[支援突击：来块曲奇]造成的伤害提升30%，属性异常积蓄效率提升20%，且该招式命中敌人时将触发[快速支援]。
cinema.descriptionEn: The DMG of Yuzuha's Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot and Assist Follow-Up: We Have Cookies increases by 30%, Anomaly Buildup Rate by 20%, and triggers a Quick Assist when it hits an enemy.

cinema.name: 残冬梦迹

cinema.name: 落地生根
cinema.description: 通过[招架支援]或[普通攻击：狸之帐]成功招架敌人攻击时额外获得1点[甜度点]，发动[支援突击：夹心硬糖射击]时可以长按【普通攻击键】进行蓄能，最多持续0.8秒，松开【普通攻击键】或蓄能至最大时间时，柚叶会额外发射强力炮弹攻击敌人。每蓄能0.4秒，柚叶都会消耗1点[甜度点]追加发射一枚强力炮弹，每颗追加强力炮弹攻击造成柚叶300%攻击力的物理伤害；[支援突击：夹心硬糖射击]的任意强力炮弹命中敌人时，会使全队角色[紊乱]效果的伤害倍率提升105%，持续40秒，最多叠加3层，每层单独结算持续时间，额外强力炮弹命中处于[甜蜜惊吓]状态的敌人时也会触发1次[普通攻击：彩糖花火·极]攻击；柚叶蓄能过程中如果受到敌人攻击，会自动闪避敌人攻击并直接发动最大蓄能攻击。
cinema.descriptionEn: Gain 1 additional Sugar Points when successfully parrying an enemy attack using a Defensive Assist or Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak. When using Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot, hold [Basic Attack] to charge for up to 0.8 seconds. Releasing [Basic Attack] or reaching full charge fires an extra powerful shell at the enemy. For every 0.4s charged, Yuzuha consumes 1 Sugar Point to fire an additional powerful shell, each dealing 300% of her ATK as Physical DMG. If any powerful shell from Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot hits an enemy, all squad members' Disorder DMG Multiplier increases by 105% for 40s, and stacking up to 3 times, with each stack duration being calculated separately. In addition, if the powerful shell hits an enemy under Sweet Scare, it'll trigger 1 Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max attack. If Yuzuha is attacked while charging, she will automatically dodge the attack and immediately unleash the max-charged attack.

basic.name: 普通攻击：狸之爪
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的打击，造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 strikes ahead, dealing Physical DMG.

basic.name: 普通攻击：狸之帐
basic.description:
长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
进入防御姿态，最多持续1.5秒，期间如果受到敌人攻击，会招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
成功招架敌人攻击时，获得1点[甜度点]；
成功招架敌人攻击时拥有无敌效果。
basic.descriptionEn:
Hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Enter a defensive stance for up to 1.5 seconds. If hit during this time, parry the attack and inflict massive Daze against the attacking enemy.
Successfully parrying an attack gains 1 Sugar Points.
Character is invulnerable when successfully parrying.

basic.name: 普通攻击：硬糖射击
basic.description:
当柚叶拥有[甜度点]时，其他操作中的角色攻击命中敌人时，柚叶会围绕敌人旋转伞持续攻击后射出一发强力炮弹，造成物理伤害，该攻击重击命中敌人时，柚叶会消耗1点[甜度点]；
[普通攻击：硬糖射击]为[追加攻击]；
[普通攻击：硬糖射击]每8秒最多触发一次；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
basic.descriptionEn:
When Yuzuha has Sugar Points, landing a hit with other active characters' attacks will have Yuzuha continuously twirl her umbrella and attack centered around the target before launching a powerful shell, dealing Physical DMG. When this attack lands a heavy attack, Yuzuha consumes 1 Sugar Point.
Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot is considered an Aftershock.
Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot can be triggered once every 8s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

basic.name: 普通攻击：彩糖花火
basic.description:
处于[甜蜜惊吓]状态下的敌人，每1秒会受到一次[普通攻击：彩糖花火]攻击；
[普通攻击：彩糖花火]攻击初始造成物理伤害；
[普通攻击：彩糖花火]攻击累积的属性异常积蓄值不参与异常伤害结算；
[普通攻击：彩糖花火]攻击的属性异常积蓄效率提升8.5%。
basic.descriptionEn:
Enemies under the effect of Sweet Scare will be attacked by a Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles once every 1s.
Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles initially deals Physical DMG.
Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles does not contribute its accumulated Attribute Anomaly Buildup toward Anomaly DMG calculation.
Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 8.5%.

basic.name: 普通攻击：彩糖花火·极
basic.description:
处于[甜蜜惊吓]状态下的敌人，被[普通攻击：硬糖射击]或[支援突击：夹心硬糖射击]重击命中时，会受到一次[普通攻击：彩糖花火·极]攻击；
[普通攻击：彩糖花火·极]攻击初始造成物理伤害；
[普通攻击：彩糖花火·极]攻击累积的属性异常积蓄值不参与异常伤害结算；
[普通攻击：彩糖花火·极]攻击的属性异常积蓄效率提升8.5%。
basic.descriptionEn:
Enemies affected by Sweet Scare will be attacked by a Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max when hit with a heavy attack from Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot or Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot.
Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max initially deals Physical DMG.
Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max does not contribute its accumulated Attribute Anomaly Buildup toward Anomaly DMG calculation.
Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 8.5%.

basic.name: 普通攻击：狸之助
basic.description:
当柚叶位于后场时，狸猫阿釜会协助操作中的角色攻击敌人，造成物理伤害；
当柚叶发动[普通攻击：狸之帐]时，狸猫阿釜会协助柚叶攻击敌人，造成物理伤害；
狸猫阿釜可以继承柚叶的初始攻击力。
basic.descriptionEn:
When Yuzuha is off-field, tanuki Kama assists the active character in attacking enemies, dealing Physical DMG.
When Yuzuha performs Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak, tanuki Kama joins her in attacking the enemy, dealing Physical DMG.
Tanuki Kama inherits Yuzuha's initial ATK.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：你要倒霉了！
basic.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行快速打击，造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Rapidly strikes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

ex.name: 特殊技：软糖轰击
ex.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方开炮射击，造成物理伤害。
ex.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Fire a cannon shot forward, dealing Physical DMG.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：小心蛀牙
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向敌人扔出炸弹，造成物理伤害；
重击命中敌人时，会使其陷入[甜蜜惊吓]状态；
发动时，获得2点[甜度点]；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Throw a bomb at the enemy, dealing Physical DMG.
Upon hitting an enemy with a heavy attack, it inflicts the Sweet Scare state.
Gains 2 Sugar Points upon activation.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：小心蛀牙，就是现在！
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, Right Now!
ex.description:
在[闪避反击：报复开始~]、[快速支援：甜点时间]、[支援突击：来块曲奇]、[支援突击：夹心硬糖射击]攻击后或触发[极限闪避]时，点按  【强化特殊技键】  发动：
向敌人快速扔出炸弹，造成物理伤害；
重击命中敌人时，会使其陷入[甜蜜惊吓]状态；
发动时，获得2点[甜度点]；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
After using Dodge Counter: Time for Payback~, Quick Assist: Dessert Time, Assist Follow-Up: We Have Cookies, or Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot, or when a Perfect Dodge is triggered, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly throw a bomb at the enemy, dealing Physical DMG.
On hitting an enemy with a heavy attack, it inflicts the Sweet Scare state.
Gains 2 Sugar Points upon activation.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ex.name: 甜蜜惊吓
ex.description:
[甜蜜惊吓]状态持续18秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
处于[甜蜜惊吓]状态下的敌人，首次被操作中的角色以与其属性相同的攻击命中时，将对该敌人触发[十人十色]，使得[普通攻击：彩糖花火]和[普通攻击：彩糖花火·极]对该敌人的攻击属性转变为触发此次[十人十色]的角色的属性；
当敌人的[甜蜜惊吓]状态被重复触发时，原本的[十人十色]状态会被移除，可再次重复上述操作，改变[普通攻击：彩糖花火]和[普通攻击：彩糖花火·极]的属性。
ex.descriptionEn:
The Sweet Scare state lasts for 18s, repeated triggers reset the duration.
When an enemy affected by Sweet Scare is first hit by an active character using an attack of their attribute, Flavor Match is triggered against that enemy, changing the attribute of Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles and Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max against that enemy to match that of the character who triggered Flavor Match.
When Sweet Scare is triggered again on an enemy, their existing Flavor Match state is removed. The process can be repeated to change the attribute of Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles and Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max again.

ultimate.name: 终结技：不投降就捣乱
ultimate.nameEn: Ultimate: Surrender or Suffer the Mischief
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对周身大范围敌人发动强力打击，造成大量物理伤害；
重击命中敌人时，会使其陷入[甜蜜惊吓]状态；
招式发动时，队伍中其他角色回复8.5点能量； 
招式发动时，获得2点[甜度点]；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating reaches Maximum, press [Ultimate] to trigger:
Unleash a powerful strike on enemies in a large area around the character, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Enemies hit with a heavy attack are inflicted with the Sweet Scare state.
Upon activating this skill, other squad members gain 8.5 Energy.
Upon activating this skill, gain 2 Sugar Points.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：甜点时间
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
